tools.name: get_agenda_events
tools.title: Get agenda events
tools.description: Retrieve agenda events for the current user, optionally filtered by RFC3339 start/end, space, and limit.

space_id.description: Space id to filter by. If omitted no space filter is applied.

limit.description: Max number of events to return.

tools.name: get_agenda_event_by_id
tools.title: Get agenda event
tools.description: Fetch a single agenda event by its id.

tools.name: create_agenda_event
tools.title: Create an agenda event
tools.description: Create a new agenda event in a space calendar. Every event MUST belong to a space: provide either space_id or the space name via 'space'. If the user didn't say which space, ASK them (or list the spaces they belong to) instead of calling without one.

space_id.description: Space id where the event is created. Optional if 'space' (a space name) is given; one of the two is required.

space.description: Space name (display or pretty name) to resolve to a space, e.g. 'EVA Space'. Used when space_id isn't known. Must be a space the user belongs to.

start.description: Event start datetime in RFC3339 format.

end.description: Event end datetime in RFC3339 format.

attendee_usernames.description: List of attendee usernames to invite (the current user is added automatically).

recurrence_frequency.description: Optional recurrence frequency: DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY, YEARLY (also HOURLY/MINUTELY/SECONDLY). Omit for a one-off event.

recurrence_interval.description: Recurrence interval (e.g. 2 = every 2 weeks). Defaults to 1 when a frequency is given.

recurrence_until.description: Optional recurrence end date (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD); the series stops on/after this date.

recurrence_count.description: Optional number of occurrences; takes precedence over recurrence_until.

fail_on_conflict.description: When true, abort creation if any attendee known to be busy clashes with the window. Default false: create anyway and return the conflicts block. The conflicts block only covers attendees whose calendar the current user may read; the others are listed under not_disclosed and were not checked, so all_available means 'no clash was found', not 'everyone is free'.

tools.name: update_agenda_event
tools.title: Update an agenda event
tools.description: Patch / update an agenda event (only provided optional fields are updated).

recurrence_frequency.description: Optional recurrence frequency (DAILY/WEEKLY/MONTHLY/YEARLY); setting it turns the event into (or updates) a whole recurring series.

recurrence_interval.description: Recurrence interval; defaults to 1 when a frequency is given.

recurrence_until.description: Optional recurrence end date (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD).

recurrence_count.description: Optional number of occurrences; takes precedence over recurrence_until.

fail_on_conflict.description: When true, abort the update if any attendee known to be busy clashes with the (new) window. Default false: update anyway and return the conflicts block. The conflicts block only covers attendees whose calendar the current user may read; the others are listed under not_disclosed and were not checked, so all_available means 'no clash was found', not 'everyone is free'.

tools.name: delete_agenda_event
tools.title: Delete an agenda event
tools.description: Delete an agenda event by its id.

tools.name: accept_agenda_event_invitation
tools.title: Accept an agenda event invitation
tools.description: Accept an agenda event invitation by the current user.

tools.name: decline_agenda_event_invitation
tools.title: Decline an agenda event invitation
tools.description: Decline an agenda event invitation by the current user. With occurrence_id this is a 'this-and-following' decline (that occurrence AND all subsequent occurrences). To cancel only ONE date of a series, use cancel_agenda_event with occurrence_id instead.

occurrence_id.description: Optional occurrence date (RFC3339) of a recurring event; when set, declines that occurrence AND every following one (this-and-future), not just that single date.

tools.name: cancel_agenda_event
tools.title: Cancel an agenda event
tools.description: Cancel an agenda event. Without occurrence_id the whole event is declined for the current user. With occurrence_id, ONLY that single occurrence of a recurring series is removed; occurrences before AND after that date are kept.

occurrence_id.description: Optional occurrence date (RFC3339) of a recurring event; when set, cancels ONLY that single occurrence (the rest of the series, before and after, is preserved).

tools.name: invite_space_to_agenda_event
tools.title: Invite space members to an agenda event
tools.description: Invite space members to an agenda event

tools.name: invite_users_to_agenda_event
tools.title: Invite users to an agenda event
tools.description: Invite users to an agenda event

attendee_usernames.description: List of attendee usernames to invite (the current user is added automatically).

tools.name: create_date_poll
tools.title: Create a date poll
tools.description: Create a date poll: a tentative event with several proposed time slots that attendees can vote on to pick a final date. Every poll MUST belong to a space: provide either space_id or the space name via 'space'. If the user didn't say which space, ASK them (or list their spaces) instead of calling without one.

space_id.description: Space id where the poll (event) is created. Optional if 'space' (a space name) is given; one of the two is required.

space.description: Space name (display or pretty name) to resolve to a space, e.g. 'EVA Space'. Used when space_id isn't known. Must be a space the user belongs to.

proposed_slots.description: Proposed slots, each as a single string '<startRFC3339>|<endRFC3339>' (e.g. '2026-02-01T14:00:00Z|2026-02-01T15:00:00Z').

attendee_usernames.description: Usernames invited to vote (the current user is added automatically).

rank_slots_by_availability.description: When true, order proposed slots so those where the most invited internal users are free come first.

tools.name: vote_date_poll
tools.title: Vote on a date poll
tools.description: Cast the current user's votes on a date poll by listing the accepted slot (date option) ids.

accepted_slot_ids.description: Date option ids the current user accepts. An empty list dismisses all options.

tools.name: get_date_poll_results
tools.title: Get date poll results
tools.description: Return each proposed slot of a date poll with its vote count and the usernames who voted for it.

tools.name: confirm_date_poll
tools.title: Confirm a date poll
tools.description: Pick the winning slot of a date poll: converts the poll into a confirmed event on that slot and returns the attendee conflict report for the confirmed window.

date_option_id.description: Winning date option id to confirm.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.title: Get users availability
tools.description: Return each user's busy and free time blocks within a window. Only time ranges are returned, never event titles, locations, attendees or calendar names. Availability is calendar content and is protected: it is readable for the current user, and for another user only when that user shares their busy time with them - each user chooses between sharing it with the people they are in a space with (the default) and sharing it with nobody, so someone outside all of a user's spaces never sees their busy time. A user who does not share it with the caller is refused, not reported as free: a refusal means their availability is UNKNOWN, and must never be presented as availability or used to pick a time.

tools.name: suggest_meeting_time
tools.title: Suggest a meeting time
tools.description: Suggest candidate slots of at least duration_minutes where all attendees are free within a window. Optional constraints keyword 'mornings' or 'afternoons' restricts candidate start times. Every attendee's busy time must be readable by the current user: that covers the people they share a space with, unless they turned the sharing off. If any one attendee does not share it with the caller, the whole call is refused rather than answered from the other calendars - their availability is UNKNOWN, not free. On a refusal, say whose availability could not be seen and ask, rather than proposing a time that may sit on top of their real commitments.

attendees.description: Usernames who must all be free.

constraints.description: Optional free-text constraint; 'mornings' (before 12:00) or 'afternoons' (from 12:00) are honored.

tools.name: get_event_attendees
tools.title: Get event attendees
tools.description: List an event's attendees together with each one's response (ACCEPTED, DECLINED, TENTATIVE or NEEDS_ACTION).

tools.name: respond_to_agenda_event
tools.title: Respond to an agenda event
tools.description: Respond to an event invitation as the current user with ACCEPTED, DECLINED or TENTATIVE. The optional comment is accepted but not persisted (no backend storage for response comments).

tools.name: set_event_reminders
tools.title: Set event reminders
tools.description: Set the current user's reminders on an event. Each reminder is a '<number> <MINUTE|HOUR|DAY|WEEK>' string (e.g. '30 MINUTE').

reminders.description: Reminders as '<number> <MINUTE|HOUR|DAY|WEEK>' strings. An empty list clears the user's reminders.

tools.name: get_event_conference
tools.title: Get event conference link
tools.description: Return the web-conference (e.g. Jitsi) link attached to an event, if any.

tools.name: set_event_conference
tools.title: Set event conference link
tools.description: Attach a web-conference link to an event (defaults type to 'web'). Passing a blank url removes the conference.

url.description: Conference URL to attach; blank to remove the existing conference.

tools.name: search_agenda_events
tools.title: Search agenda events
tools.description: Keyword search over agenda events the current user can access, optionally restricted to a space and post-filtered by a start/end date range.

start.description: Optional lower bound (RFC3339); events ending before this are excluded.

end.description: Optional upper bound (RFC3339); events starting after this are excluded.

space_id.description: Optional space id to restrict the search.
